0022600177.text: The Bulls (1-5) are on a four-game losing streak, sitting 13th in the East and 4 games back in the Central, with a 0-2 home record and a 1-3 road mark, while the Knicks (2-4) are 11th in the East and have dropped their most recent game. Chicago will be without Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury. The teams have met once this season, with New York winning 133-127 in Chicago, and the Bulls trail the 2026-27 series 0-1 after losing 1-3 to the Knicks in 2025-26.
